Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-001
Rule.Description: Detects login or credential submission over HTTP instead of HTTPS exposing credentials to interception

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-002
Rule.Description: Detects successful logins using common default usernames like admin, root, or test across services

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-003
Rule.Description: Detects more than 20 failed login attempts for a single account without lockout indicating weak lockout policy

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-004
Rule.Description: Detects attempts to bypass authentication by accessing protected endpoints without valid session tokens

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-005
Rule.Description: Detects authentication cookies lacking proper security attributes or containing predictable values

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-006
Rule.Description: Detects responses from sensitive endpoints missing Cache-Control: no-store headers

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-007
Rule.Description: Detects HTTP Basic Authentication over unencrypted connections exposing credentials in cleartext

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-008
Rule.Description: Detects privileged operations performed without MFA verification for accounts that require it

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-009
Rule.Description: Detects credential stuffing patterns with high volume login failures from the same source across multiple accounts

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-010
Rule.Description: Detects JWT tokens with algorithm set to none or missing algorithm indicating authentication bypass attempt

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-011
Rule.Description: Detects path traversal attempts using ../ sequences or encoded variants to access files outside intended directories

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-012
Rule.Description: Detects attempts to bypass authorization by manipulating role parameters in API requests

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-013
Rule.Description: Detects sequential or predictable resource ID access patterns indicating IDOR vulnerability exploitation

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-014
Rule.Description: Detects OAuth token usage where requested scopes exceed granted scopes indicating authorization bypass

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-015
Rule.Description: Detects POST/PUT/DELETE requests missing CSRF tokens indicating potential cross-site request forgery

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-016
Rule.Description: Detects session fixation where a pre-set session ID is accepted by the server after authentication

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-017
Rule.Description: Detects session tokens transmitted in URL query strings exposing them to logging and Referer headers

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-018
Rule.Description: Detects the same session token being used from different IP addresses simultaneously indicating session hijacking

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-019
Rule.Description: Detects JWT tokens with invalid signatures, expired timestamps, or algorithm manipulation

Rule.name: FSIEM-WSTG04-020
Rule.Description: Detects session cookies missing Secure, HttpOnly, or SameSite attributes
